v.s: Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions. Each explosion deals 215( +60% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies.\n(Ejected State): If Atlas has ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both himself and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.
This is Atlas' most important source of damage, which inflicts double the damage when used in Ejected State.

Atlas enters (Ejected State), gaining 40% Movement SPD and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320( +80% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies nearby and stunning them for 1s.\n(Ejected State): Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

This skill serves as Atlas' diving tool. The bonus movement speed allows him to dive into the enemy formation rapidly, while tanking a lot of damage with the Damage Reduction of this skill. When he enters the Mecha, he can control the surrounding targets again.

Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by suppressing), dealing 225( +75% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s.\nUse this skill again while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down on the designated location, dealing 360( +180% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage).\nUse this skill in (Ejected State): The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

This Ultimate is extremely powerful in teamfights, especially when combined with the fast movement speed in Ejected State. By controlling all the enemy targets in the affected area and throwing them towards your teammates, this skill can create instant wipe-out opportunities for your team.

Atlas generates (Frigid Breath) around him for 5s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by (Frigid Breath) will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 3s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s.\nAtlas gains 11-25 extra Physical & Magic Defense when (Frigid Breath) is present.
The CC and durability provided by this skill can significantly reduce the threats that Altas faces in close-quarter combats.
Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.
Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).
Unique Passive - Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage, gains 25% Magic Damage Reduction for 3s (applied before taking damage). Regains this effect 5s after leaving combat.

Unique Passive - Bladed Armor: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) plus 20% of the hero's Physical Defense to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1s.

Unique Passive - Burning Soul: Deals Magic Damage equal to 0.6% of the hero's Max HP per second to nearby enemies. This damage is increased by 140% to 350% against creeps and minions (scales with level).
